frozen_initial_policy.hypothesis: The lipophilicity source ranking transfers only weakly to hydration affinity: polar H-bond-capable heteroatom-rich cores (chlorouracil) will score at least as high as the top lipophilicity-ranked polychlorinated dioxin, while tiny apolar-surface molecules stay mid-range.

evidence_against: Two fluorines plus biphenyl apolar surface may suppress hydration below the 90.8 best.
Intramolecular H-bond in salicylate motif can reduce effective solvation.
previous_llm_decision.reasoning_summary: Only two eligible candidates; diflunisal has more polar functionality per carbon, higher GP mean and consensus rank 1, giving the best chance of exceeding the current best late in the campaign.
